newsitem.title: UK: CSC to handle Kenya Airways cargo.
newsitem.headline: CSC to handle Kenya Airways cargo.

text.p: Cargo Services Centre (CSC) said it has won a full freight handling contract for Kenya Airways, its second new customer airline this year, the first being Sabena.
The three-year agreement is effective from April 6 and follows CSC's recent move to its purpose built handling facility on the south side of London Heathrow airport.
Kenya Airways operates eight A310 flights a week between London and Nairobi and currently carries between 4,000 and 5,000 tonnes of air cargo per year.

The new contract increases the number of airlines handled by CSC at Heathrow to 12. Other airlines handled include: Singapore Airlines, Saudi Arabian Airlines, KLM, Swissair, Crossair, Martinair, Air Malta, Biman Bangladesh Airlines, JAT Yugoslav Airlines and Air UK.
CSC is a subsidiary of KLM specialising in physical cargo handling, document handling and trucking. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
